51/S0.subgoal: Explain how cyber sickness can be optimized by controlling the duration of exposure in a virtual environment.

51/S1.subgoal: Explain the factors influencing VR exposure duration and the trade-offs between movement speed and naturalness.

51/S2.subgoal: Describe the concept of a semi-interactive tour involving system-controlled navigation and limited user interaction.

51/S3.subgoal: Present the two optimization strategies for minimizing cyber sickness in a virtual tour.

51/S4.subgoal: Formulate the problem of finding a minimum duration path through all points of interest as a graph theory problem.

51/S5.subgoal: Derive the travel time between directly connected nodes using the natural walking model.

51/S6.subgoal: Describe how to map the VR navigation problem to the Traveling Salesman Problem (TSP) using hypothetical edges.

51/S7.subgoal: Outline the step-by-step algorithm for finding the optimal path, including the use of a TSP solver and the replacement of hypothetical edges.

51/S8.subgoal: Summarize the algorithm and its limitations regarding cyber sickness thresholds.
